items.title: Michael Moore interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: when Jaco Pastorious showed up playing electric bass

ctx.x: And this came in a studio situation, and you knew the fellow who was doing the arrangements?

Yeah. Well actually I went on the road with them, and he’d take two bands. We did the Dick Cavett show with him — he had big band arrangements and I played in that. And then he had his regular band on stage. So we played a couple of places where he carried two rhythm sections. And it was fun. Rhythmically that music is exciting stuff. And so it was fun. But then very shortly after that some guys started showing up who, that was their main instrument in New York. And talking about New York being a place where you…
I’m going to pause just for a second to make sure — did they change your playing schedule at all?
